main.label: An unknown blow name is looked up
main.explanation: A modded blow_effects.txt can supply a blow name that is not in the Borg's lookup table. The lookup loop visits every table entry including the NULL end marker, so the original crashes (strcmp against NULL); the corrected loop stops before the marker and returns NONE. The in-table name HURT keeps resolving.
